test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence that has NO spelling errors

options.text: Despite his youthfull appearence, the wise old man possessed a wealth of knowledge and experience.
Despite his youthfull apearance, the wise old man posessed a wealth of knowledge and experience.
Despite his youthful appearance, the wise old man possessed a wealth of knowledge and experience.
Despite his youthful apearance, the wise old man posessed a wealth of knowledge and experince.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"youthful"** means having the qualities typical of young people, such as vigor, freshness, or immaturity. (युवा)

 
 
• **Example: **Her youthful enthusiasm was infectious and motivated everyone around her.
 
 
 
• **"Appearance"** refers to the way someone or something looks. (दिखावट)
 
 
• **Example: **His appearance had changed drastically over the years.
 
 
 
• **"Possessed"** means to have or own something. (स्वामित्व)
 
 
• **Example: **She possessed a rare talent for painting.
 
 
 
• **"Experience"** refers to the knowledge or skill acquired by a period of practical experience of something. (अनुभव)
 
 
• **Example: **His years of experience in the field made him an expert.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

**The correct sentence is: **Despite his youthful appearance, the wise old man possessed a wealth of knowledge and experience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "Despite his youthfull appearence, the wise old man possessed a wealth of knowledge and experience."

 
 
• **Youthfull** (incorrect spelling of "youthful") (युवा)
 
• **Appearence** (incorrect spelling of "appearance") (दिखावट)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his youthfull appearence, the wise old man possessed a wealth of knowledge and experience.
 
• **Option 2:** "Despite his youthfull apearance, the wise old man posessed a wealth of knowledge and experience."
 
 
• **Youthfull** (incorrect spelling of "youthful") (युवा)
 
• **Apearance** (incorrect spelling of "appearance") (दिखावट)
 
• **Posessed** (incorrect spelling of "possessed") (स्वामित्व)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his youthfull apearance, the wise old man posessed a wealth of knowledge and experience.
 
• **Option 4:** "Despite his youthful apearance, the wise old man posessed a wealth of knowledge and experince."
 
 
• **Apearance** (incorrect spelling of "appearance") (दिखावट)
 
• **Posessed** (incorrect spelling of "possessed") (स्वामित्व)
 
• **Experince** (incorrect spelling of "experience") (अनुभव)
 
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his youthful apearance, the wise old man posessed a wealth of knowledge and experince.

126:Tfe2,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
